name: Oneshot Crosshair
author: Gore
description: Oneshot crosshair toggle for your waywall config. If you're using the [generic config](https://github.com/arjuncgore/waywall_generic_config) by Gore, add it to your ~/.config/waywall/extras.lua file. Download the crosshair.png [here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emnerson/downloads/main/oneshot%20crosshair.png).
